description: US · Healthcare · mercymedcolumbus.com zoominfo.com/c/mercymed-of-columbus/409041268 MercyMed of Columbus, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit community health center founded in 2011 by Dr. Grant Scarborough, MD in Columbus, Georgia, serving uninsured and low-income patients across 4 clinics. It employs 32–85 staff plus ~150 volunteers and generated ~$2.5–3.9M in revenue (2024), providing $1.5–1.7M in free care annually
